_meta.status: Oct 29 airway and breathing values from OCT28_MEDICAL_ANSWERS section 7. Textbook anchors (ATLS / TCCC / NREMT / PHTLS). Needs sign-off from a certified medic before Nov 4.
_meta.basis: ATLS / TCCC / NREMT / PHTLS textbook anchors. Fields tagged TUNE are adjustable for gameplay.
_meta.subject: Josh, adult male. Correct sizes below are his sizes. Never show his weight in UI.

airwayDevices.name: Oropharyngeal airway (OPA)
airwayDevices.sizing: Corner of mouth to earlobe or angle of jaw. Sizes 80, 90, 100 mm.
airwayDevices.tooBig: Pushes epiglottis down, patency -0.5, gag leads to vomiting.
airwayDevices.contraindication: Intact gag reflex: causes vomiting and aspiration.

airwayDevices.name: Nasopharyngeal airway (NPA)
airwayDevices.sizing: Nostril to earlobe, diameter about nostril. Sizes 26-34 Fr.
airwayDevices.tooSmall: Does not pass the tongue, no benefit.

airwayDevices.name: i-gel supraglottic airway
airwayDevices.sizing: By weight: #3 30-60 kg, #4 50-90 kg, #5 over 90 kg.
airwayDevices.tooBig: Will not seat, leak x0.6, tissue trauma.

airwayDevices.name: King LT supraglottic airway
airwayDevices.sizing: By height: #3 4-5 ft, #4 5-6 ft, #5 over 6 ft.

airwayDevices.name: Endotracheal tube (ETT)
airwayDevices.sizing: Male 7.5-8.0, female 7.0-7.5. Depth about 3 x tube size at the teeth.
airwayDevices.tooDeep: Right mainstem: left breath sounds absent, SpO2 falls, airway pressures rise.
airwayDevices.esophageal: No EtCO2 waveform. If unrecognized, SpO2 falls about 2 percent per 10 s, leading to bradycardia and arrest.
airwayDevices.confirmation: Waveform EtCO2 is the only reliable confirmation.
airwayDevices.dislodgement: A chance with every patient move unless the tube is secured.

bvm.overventilation: Rate over 12 or volume too big.
overventEffects: Gastric distension builds toward vomiting and aspiration. Also feeds tension gastrothorax if the diaphragm is ruptured.
Intrathoracic pressure rises, venous return falls, and SBP drops (worse in hypovolemia).
In TBI, the EtCO2 drop worsens outcome.

suction.flexible: 14 Fr flexible catheter for the ETT.

oxygenDelivery.name: Non-rebreather
oxygenDelivery.trap: Reservoir must be pre-inflated. If deflated, the patient rebreathes.

tank.example: A full D (2,000 psi) at 15 L per min is about 19 min.

engineCoupling_TUNE.note: TUNE: patency and FiO2 to vitals coupling. Section 7 gives device effects, not this coupling. Needs medic sign-off.
